test_get_system_library_flags: test the llvm.get_system_library_flags function to retrieve host compiler system library flags
test_ClangInvocation: test the llvm.ClangInvocation class to build Clang compilation commands with or without system includes
test_make_benchmark_from_source: test the llvm.make_benchmark_from_source function to create a benchmark from C source code strings
test_split_benchmark_by_function: test the llvm.split_benchmark_by_function to split a benchmark into individual function benchmarks
test_merge_benchmarks: test the llvm.merge_benchmarks function to merge multiple benchmarks into a single combined benchmark
